investment_strategy: Build a concentrated, AI-focused portfolio that balances platform stability with infrastructure upside. Anchor in a lower-volatility, scaled platform (Microsoft) to dampen drawdowns, pair with a high-growth platform (Alphabet) benefiting from accelerated AI monetization, and add a capped position in the dominant AI compute supplier (NVIDIA) to capture infrastructure-driven upside. Emphasize beneficiaries of enterprise AI adoption, data center build-outs, and clear monetization paths while managing elevated regulatory and export-control risks through sizing and diversification across platform and infrastructure plays. Rebalance quarterly or on 10% weight drift; no reinvestment assumed.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Integrated OpenAI across Bing/Office; heavy AI infra and power investments (including nuclear) and proactive stance on AI regulation support durable enterprise adoption.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Core ballast with lower volatility and diversified AI monetization via Office + Azure; positions the portfolio for steady AI-driven cash flow while offsetting higher volatility in other picks despite near-term bearish trend.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Rapid AI integration across search and apps with developer-facing models; antitrust scrutiny is a headwind but scale and data advantage underpin monetization.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: High-momentum, strong-growth platform levered to AI-enhanced search and cloud; sized equal to MSFT for upside, tempered by regulatory risk and higher volatility.

final_recommendations.news_factor: Dominant AI compute supplier benefitting from massive data center capex and rising power build-outs; export-control and cyclicality risks acknowledged.
final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Targeted exposure to AI infrastructure winner with exceptional growth/momentum while capping position size to manage high volatility and policy risks.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI platforms + infrastructure: balance lower-volatility platform cash flows with capped high-growth compute exposure amid data center and enterprise AI cycles.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility first, then strong growth and fast momentum. Chosen: MSFT (moderate vol, platform durability), GOOGL (strong growth/momentum despite regulatory risk), NVDA (infrastructure leader with capped allocation). Excluded: META (declining growth, slow speed), MU (very high volatility and China exposure despite strong momentum).
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive long-term on AI-led revenue and infrastructure cycles; anticipate near-term volatility from regulation, export controls, and heavy capex. Favor scaled platforms with clear monetization and AI infra beneficiaries aligned with onshoring and rising power investment.
